useCases.title: Catalog browse
useCases.intent: Explore products and view a selected product.
useCases.expectedOutcome: The selected product is available and its details are displayed.
preconditions: Product catalog is seeded with at least one available product.

useCases.title: Cart edit
useCases.intent: Build and modify a shopping cart.

actions.description: Add the product to the cart.
Change item quantity or remove an item.

useCases.expectedOutcome: The cart reflects the user's changes.
preconditions: Product catalog is seeded with at least one available product.

useCases.title: Purchase
useCases.intent: Complete a purchase and verify the resulting order.

actions.description: Add the product to the cart.
View the order and verify its contents.

useCases.expectedOutcome: An order is created with the selected item and the cart is cleared according to product behavior.
preconditions: Product catalog is seeded with at least one available product.

useCases.title: Order lookup
useCases.intent: Review existing orders and inspect one order.
useCases.expectedOutcome: The selected order is found and its details are displayed.
preconditions: At least one seeded order exists.

useCases.title: Order fulfillment
useCases.intent: Progress or cancel an order through its supported lifecycle.

actions.description: Mark the order prepared, or cancel it when cancellation is allowed.

useCases.expectedOutcome: The order reaches the requested valid state.
preconditions: A dedicated seeded order is available per concurrent iteration.
testData: One dedicated order identifier per iteration.

useCases.title: Observe state
useCases.intent: View the current commerce state in the 3D Visualizer.

actions.description: View products, cart contents, recent orders, and aggregate state.
Confirm that the scene reflects the latest available snapshot.

useCases.expectedOutcome: The current domain state is represented in the scene.
preconditions: The Visualizer's snapshot feed is reachable.

useCases.title: Subscribe live
useCases.intent: Keep the 3D Visualizer connected while commerce activity occurs.

actions.description: Observe state and workflow traffic over time.
Recover from a temporary stream interruption.

useCases.expectedOutcome: The scene remains current and reports connection degradation accurately.
preconditions: The Visualizer's live stream endpoint is reachable.
